summary.text: Michael Rutland is the Republican candidate for Washington State Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Claire Wilson.
He is a retired U.S. Air Force senior master sergeant and an insurance agent.

paragraphs.text: Rutland graduated from John Jay High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix in 2009.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1974 to 1998.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his 24 years of service included Operations Desert Shield and Desert Storm and a role as an F-22 armament systems manager, and that he later was a Boeing Defense and Space leader on the F-22 program.
Rutland advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary in second place, with 38.5 percent of the vote.
In the survey, he listed affordability, education and public safety as his key messages and named transparency and accountability as his main policy passion.
He listed the King County Republican Party, the 30th Legislative District Republicans and State Sen. Phil Fortunato among his endorsers.
